scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/adapters-node && npm run build -w packages/codegen && npm run build -w packages/react && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w packages/sdk && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/adapters-node --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/codegen --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/react --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/ui --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/sdk --noEmit && npx tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit
scripts.pack:check: cd packages/core && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../.. && cd packages/sdk && npm pack --dry-run && cd ../..
